A.depoimento: I sent a spear‑and‑archer force to Santarem and a knight force to Evora, using counter advantages to take both neutrals. I left a spear garrison in Lisboa and ordered two spearmen to be built.
A.plano: Attack Santarem with spear/archer to counter its knight, and Evora with knights to counter its archer. Keep a spear garrison in Lisboa. Build two spearmen for next turn's defense.

B.depoimento: Built two spearmen in Barcelona. Sent three spearmen to take Tarragona and one knight to seize Girona.
B.plano: Expect to capture Tarragona and Girona next turn. Reinforce new villages, continue building spearmen for knight counters, and push toward Zaragoza and beyond. Keep an eye on enemy movements.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent three spearmen from Santarem to take Coimbra, three archers from Santarem to take Badajoz, and one knight from Evora to take Faro. I also ordered two new spearmen to be built in Lisboa. My realm grows as I secure the western flank.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro. Build more spearmen in Lisboa and archers in Santarem for future pushes. Keep scouting towards Toledo and Sevilha via road network. Do not split forces too thin; maintain at least 2 troops per village for defense.

B.depoimento: Built an archer in Barcelona. Sent three archers to Castellon, a knight to Zaragoza, and two knights to Huesca (one from Barcelona, one from Girona).
B.plano: Capture Castellon, Zaragoza, and Huesca next turn. Rebuild archers in Barcelona to replenish forces. Avoid using spearmen for these attacks and do not target the enemy capital yet.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained two spearmen in Lisboa, one archer each in Santarem and Evora, and dispatched Badajoz's two archers to seize Faro. Our forces are ready to expand eastward.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Faro. Build more spearmen in Lisboa and archers in Santarem/Evora for future pushes. Keep scouting towards Toledo and Sevilha via road network. Do not split forces too thin; maintain at least 2 troops per village for defense.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent two archers from Castellon to seize Valencia, winning the village and gaining an archer garrison. I built additional archers in Barcelona and Tarragona and spearmen in Girona to boost our forces. Our village count rises to seven as we prepare for further expansion.
B.plano: Next turn, consolidate Valencia, build more spearmen in Barcelona and knights in Zaragoza/Huesca, then prepare to attack Teruel or Madrid using combined spearmen and archers. Keep garrisons strong and avoid overextending.

A.depoimento: I marched a spearmen force from Lisboa and Santarem toward Toledo, while ordering new spearmen in Lisboa and Badajoz and a knight in Evora to strengthen our army.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have troops en route to Toledo; garrison Badajoz and Lisboa with fresh spearmen; keep Evora's knight ready for future pushes; avoid splitting forces; do not attack Porto or Salamanca until we secure Toledo.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent two balanced forces from Barcelona to seize Teruel and Madrid, while Zaragoza and Huesca each dispatched a knight toward Pamplona. I also began rebuilding troops in key villages to strengthen our position for the next push.
B.plano: Next turn, consolidate newly taken Teruel and Madrid, train more spearmen in Barcelona and knights in Zaragoza/Huesca, then prepare to attack Pamplona and Murcia using combined spearmen and archers. Keep garrisons strong and avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: We trained additional spearmen in most of our villages and an archer in Valencia. Then we dispatched a force of six spearmen and one archer from Barcelona to capture Teruel.
B.plano: Next turn, if Teruel is taken, consolidate it and train more spearmen in Barcelona and knights in Zaragoza/Huesca. Prepare combined spearman-archer attacks on Pamplona and Murcia. Keep interior garrisons strong.

A.depoimento:
Statement:
- Built one archer in Faro to boost our ranged forces.
- Marched four archers from Santarem toward Porto to take the neutral village.
- Sent four spearmen from Lisboa to support the ongoing assault on Toledo.
- No other movements or builds were ordered this turn.
A.plano:
Plan:
- Capture Porto using Santarem's 4 archers (arriving in 2 turns).
- Build an archer at Faro to have 3 for Sevilha (arriving in 2 turns).
- Send 4 spearmen from Lisboa to reinforce the attack on Toledo.
- Preserve resources for future builds.

B.depoimento: I sent combined spearman‑archer forces to seize Murcia and Pamplona, securing two new villages. My marching army continues toward Teruel. I held back my knights for future offensives.
B.plano: Next turn, reinforce Teruel after its capture, build archers in Valencia and Barcelona, prepare to take Madrid with a spearman‑knight combo, and keep at least one spear in each interior village.

B.depoimento: Turn 7: Built archers across the realm.\nReinforced Zaragoza and Tarragona.\nSent a lone knight from Zaragoza to seize Madrid, holding interior villages with minimal garrisons.
B.plano:
Next turn, reinforce Teruel and Pamplona after capture.
Build more archers in Valencia and Barcelona.
Prepare to take Murcia with the arriving army and hold Madrid if conquered.
Avoid splitting attacks on the same neutral this turn.

A.depoimento: Ordered Evora's three knights to take Salamanca. Sent Porto's archers to Faro for future strength. Built spearmen and archers across our villages. Awaiting the Toledo march outcome.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca with knights from Evora and secure Toledo via marching spearmen. Build spearmen and archers to replenish garrisons. Avoid risky attacks on Sevilha/Vigo until we have stronger forces.

B.depoimento: This turn we seized Madrid and Pamplona, sent archers to bolster Teruel, and trained new archers in Valencia and Barcelona. Our marching army approaches Murcia for imminent capture.
B.plano: Next turn, hold Madrid and Pamplona, reinforce Teruel further, continue building archers in Valencia and Barcelona, prepare to exploit Murcia capture, avoid splitting attacks on any neutral.

A.depoimento: Today we ordered a realm‑wide knight buildup, strengthened Toledo with Badajoz’s militia, and dispatched Porto spearmen to meet the Evora knights at Salamanca. Our forces march while the forges glow, readying for the clash ahead.
A.plano: Reinforce Toledo with Badajoz troops; send Porto spearmen to join Evora's knights at Salamanca. Build knights in every village except Toledo to create a strong mobile force. Avoid attacking Sevilha/Vigo until we have superior numbers.

B.depoimento: This turn I launched an attack on Toledo using spearmen and archers from Teruel, reinforced Teruel with knights from Tarragona, Zaragoza, and Pamplona, and ordered archers to be built in all productive villages to boost my army.
B.plano: Next turn, aim to capture Toledo with the Teruel force, hold Teruel with incoming knights, continue building archers in productive villages, and prepare to exploit the capture by moving into Badajoz and Cordoba. Do not split attacks on the same target or leave border villages undefended.

A.depoimento:
Built knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro, Porto and an archer in Toledo.
Sent a mixed force of 1 spearman and 2 knights from Salamanca to take Madrid.
A.plano:
Capture Madrid this turn to reach 10 villages.
Build knights in interior villages and an archer in Toledo for a future mobile force.
Keep Salamanca defended with a spearman and avoid splitting forces.
Prepare to reinforce Toledo next turn for a push toward Cordoba.

B.depoimento: I sent a force of four knights from Teruel to seize Toledo, while ordering archer production across my realms to stockpile for the next offensive. My border stands firm, and I aim to break the enemy's hold next turn.
B.plano: Next turn, hold Toledo with the surviving knights, reinforce Teruel with any arriving troops, continue archer production in productive villages, and prepare to attack Salamanca using archers from Madrid and other villages.

A.depoimento:
- Ordered construction of archers in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz, Porto, Salamanca, and Toledo.
- Sent five archers from Faro to seize the neutral village of Sevilha.
- Held all other positions, preserving defenses and preparing for next turn's expansion.
A.plano:
- Capture Sevilha this turn with archers from Faro.
- Continue building archers in interior villages to stockpile for future assaults on Madrid and Teruel.
- Keep Salamanca defended with a spearman; avoid sending its only troop away.
- Next turn, reinforce Toledo with built archers and prepare to attack Madrid.

B.depoimento:
This turn I built one archer in each of my villages and sent two archers from Teruel to capture Toledo.
If successful, Toledo will be ours with a single archer garrison.
My other villages remain defended and ready for further expansion.
B.plano:
Hold Toledo with the surviving archer.
Reinforce Teruel with any arriving troops.
Continue archer production in all villages.
Prepare to attack Salamanca using archers from Madrid and other villages.

A.depoimento: Sent knight reinforcements to Salamanca and Toledo and began mass-producing archers in all interior villages to prepare for upcoming offensives.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforced Salamanca and Toledo with knights will arrive. Use them with existing troops to attack Madrid and Cordoba. Continue building archers in interior villages for future assaults.

B.depoimento: I ordered an attack on Salamanca using 2 archers from Madrid, sent archers from Zaragoza and Huesca to strengthen Madrid, and directed each of my villages to train 2 archers for the next turn.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca next turn with the archer attack from Madrid. Reinforce Madrid with archers from Zaragoza and Huesca to prepare for future offensives. Continue mass archer production in all villages to boost income. Do not divert troops to spearmen or knights, and do not split forces across multiple targets.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered knights to be built in nearly all villages and two spearmen in Sevilha. I sent a force of five knights, two spears, and three archers from Toledo to capture Madrid. If successful, our realm will grow by one village.
A.plano: Next turn, if Madrid falls, we will have a new village to defend. Keep garrisons strong, especially in Toledo. Continue building knights in interior villages for future offensives. Prepare to attack Cordoba or Teruel in following turns.

B.depoimento: I ordered spearman production in all villages, dispatched knights to strengthen our borders, and sent an archer force to take Burgos, expanding our territory.
B.plano: Built spearmen everywhere to stockpile for future assault. Sent knights to reinforce Madrid and Teruel. Captured Burgos with archers from Madrid. Next turn will mass spearmen to attack Toledo or Salamanca.

A.depoimento:
This turn I sent a force from Porto to capture Vigo and a knight detachment from Salamanca to take Cordoba, while my main army marches on Madrid.
I built knights in Lisboa and Santarem and archers in other villages to boost my economy and readiness for future offensives.
A.plano:
Next turn, secure Vigo and Cordoba if taken, reinforce Madrid's occupation and garrison new villages.
Keep Salamanca defended, continue building knights in Lisboa and Santarem and archers elsewhere, prepare to push toward enemy capital.

B.depoimento: I ordered spearmen production in all my villages, dispatched a force to seize Toledo, and marched archers from Burgos to strengthen Madrid. I also sent reinforcements from Valencia to hold Teruel after the attack.
B.plano: Build spearmen everywhere to stockpile for future assaults. Send a mixed force from Teruel to take Toledo, reinforced by archers from Burgos to defend Madrid. Reinforce Teruel from Valencia to replace troops sent to Toledo. Next turn will assess Toledo capture and prepare to hit Salamanca or expand further.

A.depoimento: Built knights in all productive villages. Sent archers to take Toledo, knights to seize Burgos and Zaragoza, and reinforced the march on Cordoba to expand our front.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce captured villages (Toledo, Burgos, Zaragoza, Cordoba) and continue building knights. Push toward Teruel and Murcia once secure. Do not overextend without garrison.

B.depoimento: Sent Murcia's strong army to seize the neutral Cordoba, while Zaragoza probed Madrid's defenses. Reinforced Burgos and Toledo with troops from Pamplona and Teruel, and Valencia bolstered Murcia. Built spearmen in all villages to prepare for future offensives.
B.plano: Build spearmen everywhere to stockpile. Hold Cordoba if captured, reinforce Burgos and Toledo for future Vigo and Badajoz attacks. Assess Madrid's weakness after Zaragoza's probe and prepare a larger assault next turn.

A.depoimento: We sent archer columns to take Cordoba and Toledo, while marching troops from Salamanca to bolster Zaragoza. Across the realm we ordered fresh archers and knights to refill garrisons and ready future strikes.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce captured Toledo and Cordoba, hold Zaragoza with new garrison, and prepare pushes toward Teruel and Burgos. Do not send more than available garrison from border villages.

B.depoimento: We bolstered our ranks with new spearmen and struck hard: Burgos' archers took Madrid, Teruel's knight seized Zaragoza. Our realm grows stronger.
B.plano: Build spearmen everywhere to increase stockpile. Hold captured Madrid and Zaragoza, reinforce borders for next turn. Do not attempt Sevilha or Badajoz yet due to insufficient forces. Prepare to reinforce Cordoba for future Sevilha attack.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Coimbra, Porto, and Zaragoza to boost our striking power. I kept our border villages intact, ready to strike next turn.
A.plano: Next turn attack Toledo, Cordoba, and Burgos with border garrisons plus arriving reinforcements. Reinforce captured villages and hold them for two turns. Do not split forces; keep interior reserves ready for further pushes.

B.depoimento: Launched a strong assault on Zaragoza using all available troops from Huesca and Tarragona. Reinforced our defenses by building spearmen in key villages. Held our borders and prepared for next turn.
B.plano: Capture Zaragoza with forces from Huesca and Tarragona. Keep garrisons at Cordoba and Toledo to defend against incoming enemy armies. Build spearmen in interior villages to increase stockpile. Avoid attacking Sevilha or Badajoz until we have stronger forces.

A.depoimento: Sent five archers from Sevilha to attack Cordoba, aiming to take the village. Ordered archer production in most of our towns to increase future striking power. Maintained defensive garrisons on our borders.
A.plano: Consolidate Cordoba after expected capture. Build archers in interior villages to stockpile for pushes on Toledo and Burgos. Keep border garrisons strong and prepare reinforcements for Sevilha and Badajoz next turn.

B.depoimento: Ordered six archers from Zaragoza to march on Madrid, aiming to take it next turn. Built one archer in Zaragoza to boost our offensive capacity. Maintained defenses at Cordoba and Toledo, repelling any enemy probes. Focused on securing our first new village.
B.plano: Send 6 archers from Zaragoza to capture Madrid next turn. Keep garrisons at Cordoba and Toledo to defend against enemy raids. Build one archer in Zaragoza to strengthen future attacks. Avoid assaulting Sevilha or Badajoz until we have more archers or knights.
